r2 (2026-09-25): the power-resource operating identity (Consumption = Energy Supply x Power Resource per Energy) is scoped to Modes 25-26. The consumption flow is gated by [Power Resource Enabled], so in Modes 0-24 it is 0 while Energy Supply is not; as a global check it failed every legacy mode. Modes 0-24 instead assert the switch-off state: consumption 0, extraction 0, fulfillment 1, inventory a dead stock at 5000, price at base.

r2: the price channel reads [X Perceived Power Resource Fulfillment] (inventory coverage of the smoothed demand signal), not the physical rationing ratio, which closed an algebraic loop price -> demand -> rationing -> price in Modes 25-26.
